_doc: HIT PARADE - BRAWL BREAK goon clips (lane ASSETS owns this file). Baked on top of tools/clipplan/_shared.json for every goon_* body in tools/bodies.json by `python tools/build_fighters.py --goons`.
Entries use the fighter clipplan fields (CONTRACT 6.2 / 20.5); keys starting '_' are ignored except `_override`: {goonId: {clipId: entry}} replaces / adds an entry for ONE goon.

The three goon attacks (CONTRACT 4.3.14: 'goon kits = 3 shared simple moves') + a taunt. Sources and contact frames are the research picks (_research/animations/MIXAMO_CLIPS.md, front-pass frames): the same windows lane FIGHTERS already proved on bruno / zambini (haymaker [16,52] c29, big_boot [8,40] c22, palm_shove [28,62] c43).
data/goons.json (generated by tools/goons_data.py from data/clips/goon_*.clips.json) carries the frame data SIM's brawl.ts reads.

goon_shove._why: double-palm shove (research: 'push into wall / hazard'), two hands out at 1.1 m; shoves the player away

goon_haymaker._why: the reference's big haymaker hook (research front pass f29, fist 0.77 m ahead at 1.15 m)

goon_kick._why: front push kick (research: knockback, leg fully extended at the front pass f22)

goon_taunt._why: chest-thump taunt (research 'Taunts'); goons taunt between attack tokens
show security: battle-cry taunt instead of the chest thump (variety across the three goons)
show medic: an irritated 'get out of my ward' gesture rather than a brawler's taunt
